decisions.reason: The source and local context refer specifically to the ESP32 decoupling capacitors, not the AXP2101 or MT3608 decoupling placement.
Leaving the ESP32 decoupling capacitors unchanged does not alter the ESP32 breakout header pitch.
The backlight circuit's PWM decoupling capacitor is unrelated to the ESP32 module decoupling discussed by the source.
The ESP32 decoupling decision does not change any connector, enclosure, orientation, accessibility, or antenna-layout constraint.
The decision concerns integrated-board ESP32 supply decoupling and does not affect addressable-LED supply or logic-level handling.
The source does not change AXP2101 PWROK, VBACKUP, VRTC, or their test-pad and auxiliary-pin requirements.
The source applies to the integrated board's ESP32 decoupling configuration, not the separate main-board decoupling requirement.
Leaving existing ESP32 capacitors unchanged does not modify the integrated board's cost, sourcing, or connector-reduction policies.
The local decoupling decision does not alter the single-board architecture or functional-consolidation requirement.
The source does not change the main board's standalone USB activation, LDO capacity, or powered scope.
The ESP32 decoupling decision does not alter the AXP2101 selection, required rails, simultaneous charging, or battery-efficiency goals.
Leaving ESP32 decoupling capacitors unchanged does not affect the high-current net widths, stubs, or inner-layer copper-pour routing.
